To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) Pareto optimal resource allocations in networks are determined by the balance of power among the network entities, and b) a balance of power principle is sufficient for decentralized resource sharing in networks.
a) Pareto optimal decentralized resource sharing is possible in networks with multiple resources, and b) the resulting allocations can be characterized by the “Balance of Power” principle.

“A Pareto-optimal resource allocation can be achieved by a decentralized mechanism, in which each resource owner adjusts its allocation, in a direction that increases the ratio between its own utility and the aggregate utility of all other resource owners.”
